Deprecated packages: none detected in the touched files. Everything works end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _scope() (line 300) correctly returns {company_id} when a user has a company so quotes are shared across the company; owners' existing private quotes are migrated onto the company at POST /api/company via update_many({user_id, company_id:null}) -- good.

server.py _invoice_url() signs a 365-day JWT with typ='invoice' and sub=quote_id; invoice_pdf() enforces both via jwt.decode options require sub/exp and typ + sub match -- correct signature + mismatch handling.
/api/invoices/{quote_id}.pdf requires payment_status='paid' before generating, so a paid-only link cannot leak unpaid quote data.
admin_update_quote() (server.py:886) blocks edits when payment_status=='paid' before any mutation -- matches spec.
change_password() hashes with bcrypt rounds=12 in a thread to avoid blocking the event loop; verification uses bcrypt.checkpw -- good.
/api/company/invite case-normalises email to lowercase before user lookup and pending-invite upsert -- prevents duplicate casing invites.
DELETE /api/company/members/{member_id} guards against removing the owner (400) and only clears company fields matching the current company_id (safe).
login.tsx (line 76) sets scrollEnabled={false} on KeyboardAwareScrollView; verified non-scrollable in web viewport.
